dedupe_keys.name: historico de informacion transito de sabaneta

description: Histórico de Información Tránsito de Sabaneta is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Alcaldía de Sabaneta, Antioquia. Presenta la información histórica de las licencias de conducción y de transporte público para el municipio de Sabaneta Conozca estadísticas, indicadores y mapas sobre Sabaneta en el portal www.observatoriosabaneta.org. Coverage: Alcaldía de Sabaneta, Antioquia. The portal files it under the publisher Alcaldía de Sabaneta, Antioquia. Its tags are sabaneta, transito, conducción. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Transporte. The portal shows 2021-06-03 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
